jobs.subject: A white composition sheet with three large simple geometric shapes: indigo circle, pale square and lime triangle, with a magnifying glass overlapping one corner. It represents reading the relations among visual elements.
jobs.prompt: Create ONE standalone decorative educational editorial illustration for a CVeDI lesson objective card. Match the style of the reference: bold rounded dark navy outlines, simple familiar compact forms, opaque white and pale colored surfaces, very restrained dimensional edge, readable at 96px. Use indigo-950 #1E1B4B outlines, indigo-800 #3730A3, indigo-100 #E0E7FF, white, one lime #A3E635 accent. Square canvas, motif occupies 72%, at least 12% genuinely transparent margins, opaque object interiors, transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, backdrop, enclosing badge, halo, extra objects.
